cities.name: Sydney
cities.description: A vibrant city known for its iconic Opera House, beautiful Harbour Bridge, and world-class surfing at Bondi Beach.

cities.name: Melbourne
cities.description: The cultural capital of Australia, famous for its hidden laneways, exceptional coffee, and dynamic arts scene.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.description: A bustling metropolis where ultra-modern skyscrapers meet traditional temples and serene gardens.

cities.name: Kyoto
cities.description: The heart of traditional Japan, renowned for its classical Buddhist temples, gardens, and imperial palaces.

cities.name: Sao Paulo
cities.description: A vibrant financial hub and the most populous city in Brazil, known for its diverse culinary scene and nightlife.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro
cities.description: Famous for its stunning coastline, the Christ the Redeemer statue, and the energetic Carnival festival.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: An ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of the Yamuna river in the Indian city of Agra.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A Hindu-Buddhist temple complex in Cambodia and the largest religious monument in the world by land area.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A small South Pacific island northwest of Tahiti, surrounded by sand-fringed islets and a turquoise lagoon.

beaches.name: Copacabana, Brazil
beaches.description: One of the most famous beaches in the world, known for its crescent-shaped beach and black-and-white wave pattern promenade.

beaches.name: Clearwater Beach, FL
beaches.description: Consistently ranked as one of the best beaches in the US, known for its white sand and emerald waters.

beaches.name: Miami Beach, FL
beaches.description: A glamorous world-famous beach known for its Art Deco district, turquoise waters, and vibrant nightlife.

beaches.name: Lanikai Beach, Oahu Hawaii
beaches.description: A small, world-renowned beach known for its fine white sand and spectacular views of the Mokulua Islands.
